titleEn: The Other Side of the Wall
summary: The survivors reach the sea. The water is real, and it is also the edge of a war they can now name. Season three ends with salt on their hands and Marley beyond the horizon.

segments.ja: シガンシナを出た生存者は、本を抱えて壁の内側へ戻ります。戻る列は、開幕の遠征より短いです。短い列の中に、ハンジと、リヴァイと、エレンと、ミカサと、アルミンがいます。いる顔の数が、完全試合のスコアです。スコアを、彼らは街の門でまだ大きな声にしません。しないまま、本は女王のもとへ届きます。届く頁が、壁の政治を次の段階へ押し出します。押し出す中身は、マーレという国です。
segments.en: The survivors who left Shiganshina return inside the walls holding the book. The line that returns is shorter than the expedition of the opening. Inside the short line are Hange, Levi, Eren, Mikasa, and Armin. The number of faces that are there is the score of the perfect game. They do not yet make the score into a loud voice at the town gate. Without making it, the book reaches the queen. The pages that arrive push the politics of the walls to the next stage. The content that pushes is a country called Marley.

segments.ja: 女王は、地下室の本を個人の物語としてではなく、国の前提として受けます。受ける前提は、壁の外に敵の政府がある、です。ある政府に対し、彼女は遠征の続きを許可します。許可の理由は、海まで確認し、脅威の距離を測る、です。測る命令が、壁の向こう側という言葉を軍事にします。軍事の前に、彼女は死者の名を一度聞きます。聞く名の中に、エルヴィンがいます。いる名を、女王は短く黙礼します。
segments.en: The queen receives the book from the basement not as a personal story but as the premise of the country. The premise she receives is that there is an enemy government outside the walls. Toward the government that is there, she permits the continuation of the expedition. The reason for the permission is to confirm as far as the sea and measure the distance of the threat. The order of measuring makes the words the other side of the wall into a military matter. Before the military matter, she hears the names of the dead once. Among the names she hears is Erwin. The queen bows once to that name.

segments.ja: フロックは、帰還の列の端にいます。いる端で、彼は悪魔が選ばれなかったことをまだ言います。言う相手は、もう団長ではありません。団長がいない兵団を、彼は不完全だと見ます。見る不完全さは、アルミンが戻ったことへの拒否です。拒否は、今日は命令違反にはなりません。なりません。ならないまま、種は残ります。残る種が、壁の中の次の季節の火種です。火種を、リヴァイは見ています。見ても、今日は摘みません。
segments.en: Floch is at the edge of the line of the return. At the edge where he is, he still says that a devil was not chosen. The opponent he says it to is no longer the Commander. He sees the corps without the Commander as incomplete. The incompleteness he sees is a refusal toward Armin having returned. The refusal does not become insubordination today. It does not. Without becoming it, the seed remains. The seed that remains is the kindling of the next season inside the walls. Levi is watching the kindling. Even watching, he does not pull it out today.

segments.ja: 頁のあと、調査兵団は壁の外のさらに先へ出ます。出る目的は、アルミンの絵が塩の水かどうかの確認です。確認の列は、シガンシナの再戦より静かです。静かな理由は、鎧も超大型も、もう目の前にいない、です。いない道に、無垢の巨人はまだいます。いる巨人を、彼らは手順で抜けます。抜ける先に、地形が開けます。開ける予感を、アルミンが最初に嗅ぎます。嗅ぐ空気は、壁の中の風と違います。
segments.en: After the pages, the Survey Corps goes even farther outside the walls. The purpose of going is to confirm whether Armin's picture is salt water. The line of the confirmation is quieter than the rematch at Shiganshina. The reason it is quiet is that neither the Armor nor the Colossal is in front of them anymore. On the road where they are not, Pure Titans are still there. They pass the Titans that are there by procedure. Ahead of the passing, the land opens. Armin is the first to smell the premonition of opening. The air he smells differs from the wind inside the walls.

segments.ja: 丘を越えたとき、水平の水が現れます。現れる水は、川の幅ではありません。幅ではなく、端が見えない面です。見えない面を、アルミンは海だと名づけます。名づける声は、子供の本の音です。音のあと、列は馬を止めます。止める理由は、絵が実物になった、です。実物の水は、太陽を反射します。反射する明るさが、地下室の暗い棚の反対です。反対の景色が、壁の向こう側の最初の報酬です。
segments.en: When they cross the hill, a horizontal water appears. The water that appears is not the width of a river. It is not a width. It is a surface whose edge cannot be seen. Armin names the surface that cannot be seen the sea. The voice that names it is the sound of a child's book. After the sound, the line stops the horses. The reason they stop is that the picture became a real thing. The water of the real thing reflects the sun. The brightness that reflects is the opposite of the dark shelf of the basement. That opposite view is the first reward.

segments.ja: エレンは、波の線の先を見ます。見る先に、父の使命が重なります。重なる使命は、座標を取り戻せ、の続きです。続きは、海の向こうの敵を消せ、に近づいています。近づく読みを、彼はまだ全員には言いません。言わない理由は、アルミンの笑いを今日は壊さない、です。壊さない沈黙の中で、彼の拳は硬質化の癖を思い出します。思い出す拳が、壁の向こう側のエレンです。エレンは、もう海を夢の名詞では持っていません。
segments.en: Eren looks past the line of the waves. His father's mission overlaps the place he looks. The mission that overlaps is the continuation of take back the coordinate. The continuation is approaching erase the enemy beyond the sea. He does not yet say to everyone the reading that approaches. The reason he does not say it is not to break Armin's laugh today. Inside the silence of not breaking it, his fist remembers the habit of hardening. The fist he remembers is Eren of the other side of the wall. The sea is no longer only a dream.

He is not looking at the laughing heir as a replacement for the Commander. Not looking is the distance after pointing the needle. The distance does not shrink even at the sea.

segments.en: The line turns the horses toward the walls with the sea at their backs. The reason they turn is to deliver the pages, the confirmation of the salt, and the report of the dead. vocab.exampleEn: The queen receives the book from the basement not as a personal story but as the premise of the country. The premise she receives is that there is an enemy government outside the walls. Toward the government that is there, she permits the continuation of the expedition. The reason for the permission is to confirm as far as the sea and measure the distance of the threat. The order of measuring makes the words the other side of the wall into a military matter. Before the military matter, she hears the names of the dead once. Among the names she hears is Erwin. The queen bows once to that name.
